fact: The Primature reports that AGEFAU's revised 2026 programme, adopted on 23 July 2026, includes extending network coverage and deploying Centres d'Acces Universel, Cases Wifi and Cases Numeriques to democratise internet access.
AGEFAU says its revised 2026 budget of FCFA 27.89bn retains network coverage extension in 162 localities of Mali, 80 Centres d'Acces Universel and 100 Cases Wifi.

AGEFAU, Mali's universal access fund agency, plans to spend FCFA 43.35bn in 2025 on improving population access to telecom services, continuing network coverage extension and universal access centres, per its communiqué of 13 March 2025.

The Mali government's universal access fund agency AGEFAU adopted a 2027 budget of about FCFA 58.75 billion on 26 November 2026, to extend network coverage to 162 localities and build 48 universal access centres in public secondary schools.
